name: Fetish Love: NSFW Dating Sim
source: A detective visual novel where you investigate a university blackmail case while romancing four unique girls. Your choices shape the mystery AND the relationships. Multiple endings. Alternative romance stories. Can you uncover the truth... and their hearts?
translation: 一部侦探题材视觉小说，你将在调查一桩大学勒索案的同时，与四位性格迥异的女孩展开恋情。你的选择不仅左右着案件的真相，也塑造着彼此的关系。多重结局，不同走向的恋爱篇章。你能否揭开真相……并赢得她们的芳心？
